items.question: Which four substances are named for the Lakṣmīsundara pīṭha's construction?
premises: Lakṣmīsundara pīṭha is established by parts.
Earth-lotus cane lotus slab are listed.
These items complete the pīṭha's material set.
items.inference: The verse enumerates the pīṭha's constituent materials.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case and ritual role of each item remain undetermined.
